Detect deconvolution windows from the FID

detect_fid_windows.Rd

Finds FID peaks (including shoulders) with detect_peaks() and merges them into padded, localized windows with non-overlapping ownership cores.

Usage

detect_fid_windows(exp)

Arguments

exp

A gcms_fid_exp object.

Value

A tibble with window_id, start_rt, end_rt (FID time, min), n_peaks, peak_ids, n_scans (MS scans inside the window after removing the alignment delay) and has_shoulder (logical; any peak in the window has an unresolved shoulder). The peak table is attached as attr(, "peaks"). exp is not modified. Nonempty tables also contain core_start_rt, core_end_rt and core_last; a shared boundary belongs to the core on its right.

Details

Padding and merge gap come from the moosaic.window_padding and moosaic.window_merge_gap options. A warning is issued for windows with fewer than moosaic.min_scans_per_window scans. moosaic.window_max_width (default 0.5 min) limits core width and moosaic.window_max_peaks (default 4) limits detected apexes per core, except coincident apexes. Set both to Inf for legacy merged windows. Localized fit intervals are expanded when necessary to include at least two available MS scans; ownership cores are unchanged.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  windows <- detect_fid_windows(exp)
} # }
